visualReview.observation: Three actual fronts, report ages/unknown supply and route preview are visible. Internal squad naming remains exposed as player_clan 1; no general wording/readability certification.
Monochrome shapes are present, as measured by the case. Small text is dense and clipped at the map boundary; no human legibility certification.
The automatic final screen visibly names Zone d’insertion and expiry in both subtitle and debrief after cleanup. Its132 NPC losses are the explicitly assisted isolation, not natural combat kills.
The first evolved attempt has the normal HUD but no battle panel/minimap data while the fixture is frozen before the first strategic HUD update. This failed attempt is preserved.
The basic variant states Carrier/Ravager, six already allocated parasites and capacity 6. Long authored front labels overlap one another in the briefing map.
The evolved variant explicitly states Supercarrier capacity 12, six already allocated parasites and the Ravager resilience/fire/excess-damage counterplay. The same map-label overlap persists.

Both actual optional checkboxes are visibly checked and the evolved explanation is displayed. The bound-operation provenance says Xenomorph Prime while the old Gunnison terrain card can remain highlighted.

After genuine checkpoint reload and zero-time strategic refresh, the actual four-front HUD/panel is present. Its long authored names overload the small minimap; no performance or appearance certification follows.

remainingVisualIssues.issue: Long LV-742 front names overlap the briefing canvas and minimap.
remainingVisualIssues.suggestedFollowup: Provide concise display names and an accessible full-text legend or controlled wrapping; keep full authored descriptions in the objectives panel.

remainingVisualIssues.issue: The terrain card highlight can remain on an earlier manually selected biome when a bound catalogue operation selects another actual map.
remainingVisualIssues.suggestedFollowup: Synchronize or clearly disable the manual terrain selection for bound catalogue operations. Current actual scene/provenance/configuration are correctly Xenomorph Prime.

remainingVisualIssues.issue: Generic internal squad labels such as player_clan 1 remain visible in command controls.
remainingVisualIssues.suggestedFollowup: Give squads human-readable display labels while preserving their actual stable IDs.
